Name: Voids OURple AT and FS Tool Retexture
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
OURplefication continues! This time I bring you the lovely Alternative Textures and Fashion Sense tools retextured to fit the OURple™!
No replacing needed, it comes with the code to automatically change your tools texture.

Become OURple.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher. 
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
